title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 10: Hanun's insult to David's servants and Israel's victories over Ammon and the Syrians.

questions.text: After the king of the children of Ammon died, who reigned in his place?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:1 says the king of the children of Ammon died and Hanun his son reigned in his place.

questions.text: Why did David send his servants to Hanun?
questions.explanation: David wanted to show kindness to Hanun, so he sent his servants to comfort him concerning his father.

answers.text: To ask for help against the Syrians
To comfort him concerning his father

questions.text: What did Hanun do to David's servants?
questions.explanation: Hanun shaved off one half of their beards and cut off their garments in the middle, and sent them away.

answers.text: He put them in prison and took their weapons
He shaved half their beards and cut their garments
He gave them gifts and sent them home in peace
He made them serve in his army for a year

questions.text: Where did David tell his ashamed servants to wait until their beards had grown?
questions.explanation: The king said, "Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return."

questions.text: Whom did the children of Ammon hire when they saw they had become odious to David?
questions.explanation: They hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and of Zobah, the king of Maacah, and the men of Tob.

answers.text: The Philistines of Gath and Ekron
The Syrians of Beth Rehob and of Zobah

questions.text: To whom did Joab commit the rest of the people to fight the children of Ammon?
questions.explanation: Joab committed the rest of the people into the hand of Abishai his brother and put them in array against the children of Ammon.

questions.text: Joab said, "Be courageous, and let's be strong for our people, and for..." what?
questions.explanation: Joab said, "Be courageous, and let's be strong for our people, and for the cities of our God."

questions.text: To which place did the Syrians from beyond the River come, where David then fought them?
questions.explanation: The Syrians came to Helam, and David gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, and came to Helam.

questions.text: Who was the captain of Hadadezer's army whom David struck so that he died?
questions.explanation: Shobach was the captain of the army of Hadadezer, and David struck him so that he died there.

questions.text: What did the kings who served Hadadezer do after they were defeated?
questions.explanation: When they saw they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them.

answers.text: They fled to Egypt with their gods
They made peace with Israel and served them
They joined the children of Ammon again
